Name: Frame Rate Viewer
Author: Adham084
Description:
[size=6]Overview[/size]
Adds a fully customizable frame rate counter, because Afterburner have some issues with SMAPI.
Can be configured via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional dependency) or just use the config file.

If you like this mod, feel free to give it a thumbs up and check my other mods.

[size=6]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into "Stardew Valley/Mods".
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
